name: io.github.brunopompeo1/crypto-perp-pulse-x402
title: Crypto Perp Pulse & Outage Radar (x402)
description: Live Hyperliquid funding/squeeze radar + AI & crypto provider outage radar, pay-per-call x402.

tools.name: hyperliquid_perp_funding_radar
tools.description: Reads every Hyperliquid perpetual market live and returns, per market, the 1-hour and 8-hour funding rate and its annualised APR, mark and oracle price with basis in basis points, open interest and 24-hour volume in USD, 24-hour change and maximum leverage, each tagged LONG_CROWDED (APR at or above 25 %), SHORT_CROWDED (at or below -10 %) or NEUTRAL with a squeeze bias. It adds a market summary with the aggregate regime BULLISH_OVERHEATED, BEARISH_SHORT_CROWDED or BALANCED and a squeeze radar with the five most long-crowded and five most short-crowded liquid markets. Use it for funding-rate carry or basis trades, to spot crowded positioning before entering a leveraged trade, or to add derivatives sentiment to a market report. Do not use it for spot prices or order books, for other exchanges, which are not covered, or as a trade signal on its own. Live data that changes every hour; call again rather than caching. Read 'marketSummary.aggregateRegime', 'squeezeRadar' and 'markets'. Costs 0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with ok false and 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Read-only market and status data; it places no orders and holds no keys.

symbol.description: Optional comma-separated Hyperliquid tickers such as 'BTC,ETH,SOL,HYPE', case-insensitive. When given, only these markets are returned and 'top' is ignored; an unknown ticker is simply absent from 'markets'.

symbols.description: Same filter as 'symbol' given as a list, for example ['BTC', 'ETH']. Both can be combined.

top.description: When no symbol filter is given, how many markets to return, ranked by open interest. Default 15, clamped to 1 to 50.

minOiUsd.description: Minimum open interest in USD for a market to enter the squeeze radar, so thin markets do not dominate it. Default 500,000. Does not filter 'markets'.

tools.name: ai_crypto_outage_radar
tools.description: Checks right now the public status pages of 10 providers that agent pipelines depend on (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cloudflare, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Base, Coinbase, Solana and Alchemy), with each one's status indicator, active incidents and response latency, and probes the Base mainnet RPC for its latest block and latency. It returns a single recommendation for the calling agent: ALL_SYSTEMS_GO, PROCEED_WITH_RETRY_GUARD or USE_FALLBACK_OR_DELAY, plus the list of degraded providers. Use it before a long or costly run, before an on-chain payment or deploy, or to explain why a dependency is failing and pick a fallback model or chain. Do not use it for providers outside the list, for historical uptime or SLAs, or for the agent's own servers. Reflects the providers' own status pages, which can lag a real incident by minutes. Read 'agentRecommendation' and 'degradedProviders'. Costs 0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with ok false and 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Read-only market and status data; it places no orders and holds no keys.

category.description: Limit the check to one group: 'ai' (OpenAI, Anthropic), 'cloud' (Cloudflare, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase), 'crypto' (Base, Coinbase, Solana, Alchemy) or 'all' (default).
